about: What npm run up can install, and how much disk each part takes (MB, measured on a Mac with Docker Desktop, 2026-10-20). Parts are shared pieces: a component lists the parts it needs, and a part shared by several is counted once. A component's own mb is its language in the compiler sandbox. TypeScript and Bash run in images of their own, and the project courses (read lessons) and the playground need nothing here. scripts/lib/components.mjs installs and removes them, and the app's install hints read the same names and sizes.
